title: Graph Lookup Interface
description: The seam between reconciliation and a design graph implementation.
body: The seam between this crate and a real Schematify design graph. `crates/schematify-core` is built in parallel by another wave and this crate must not depend on it. Reconciliation depends only on [`GraphLookup`], small enough that implementing it later is one `impl` block and no change to [`crate::reconcile`]. For the wiring wave: implement `GraphLookup` for whatever `schematify-core` exposes as its loaded graph, and pass that in place of `JsonFileGraph`. Nothing else in this crate needs to change.
